---
title: "Course Guide"
---

## TRACE

TRACE is the shared learning message of the course, not a topic or a software tool.

> **Predict → Encounter → Probe → Explain → Decide → Verify**

You will use the same cycle on different objects: a news claim, search result, recommendation, algorithmic decision, LLM response, prompt, citation, policy, or professional case.

## Weekly rhythm

Every ordinary teaching week contains four persistent components:

| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| **Pre-Class Quiz** | Make preparation visible and activate prior knowledge |
| **TRACE Lab** | Experience, investigate, manipulate, explain, and verify a real case |
| **After-Class Task** | Produce individual evidence of transfer |
| **Next on DSA261** | Establish the shared reading/viewing culture for the next week |

## Official class schedule

DSA261 is scheduled on **Friday in G2-04** as three 40-minute class periods:

| Time | Phase | Typical activity |
|---|---|---|
| **11:00–11:40** | Session 1 | cold case, prediction, encounter, focused concept, guided investigation |
| **11:40–11:50** | Short break | — |
| **11:50–12:30** | Session 2 | probing, information seeking, guided technical practice |
| **12:30–13:30** | Lunch break | — |
| **13:30–14:10** | Session 3 | pair challenge, decision, verification, evidence capture, next-week briefing |

Although the course is formally listed as theoretical, teaching takes place in the computer laboratory. The design therefore treats each class period as an active TRACE session rather than as a continuous lecture.

Students should normally perform an observable action at least every 10–15 minutes.

## Weekly Tasks

Weekly Tasks are not essays. They are evidence records showing how you searched, prompted, probed, verified, and decided.

AI use is permitted unless a specific task says otherwise. However:

> **AI output is not verification evidence.**

## Assessment direction

- **Week 7:** TRACE Midterm Challenge synthesising W1–W6 evidence and skills.
- **Weeks 12–13:** Final Project Gate 1 and Gate 2; the project scope and evidence protocol are progressively fixed.
- **Week 14:** course review, transfer challenge, and final readiness audit.
